title.en: Know the route, know the signs

body.en: Where you are going, how you get there at night, what actually means go now. Not so you can be calm, but so she does not have to be the one who knows.
body.hi: Kahan jaana hai, raat mein kaise pahunchna hai, aur asal mein kya matlab hai ki ab chalna hai. Isliye nahi ki aap shaant rahein, balki isliye ki use hi sab pata rakhna na pade.
